# Own the Block v1.9.1 — Online hosting reliability

Own the Block 1.9.1 improves Online room startup and troubleshooting on networks where a new Cloudflare Quick Tunnel hostname is slow to resolve. It keeps Socket protocol **14**, room snapshot schema **11**, and minimum supported version **1.9.0**. Multiplayer rules and LAN hosting are unchanged.

## Downloads

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | `OwnTheBlock-1.9.1-win32-x64-Setup.exe` |
| macOS Intel | `OwnTheBlock-1.9.1-macos-x64.dmg` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `OwnTheBlock-1.9.1-macos-arm64.dmg` |

The release also provides the Windows Squirrel `RELEASES` file and `own_the_block-1.9.1-full.nupkg` for in-app updates, plus `SHA256SUMS.txt` and `update-manifest.json`. Packages are **unsigned**; the macOS builds are **not notarized**. Download only from the official GitHub Release.

## Online hosting

- Public route checks use Electron's network stack and validate both the public `/readyz` endpoint and the game page before the Host receives an invitation link. Room activation then probes the actual public room.
- A newly announced tunnel hostname can be retried through bounded DNS and HTTP failures. On DNS errors the app observes system and Electron resolution, clears Electron's host-resolver cache, and reports a safe diagnostic without exposing the invitation URL or secrets.
- Tunnel registration is observed before public probing when cloudflared reports it. If that log line is absent, a bounded fallback allows public verification to decide readiness. Tunnel loss withdraws the old invitation and recovery uses a new link while the original host process remains alive.

On the previously failing Windows PC, the owner reported repeated successful Online room creation with Windows Defender enabled using the rc.2 candidate. Reported startup time was about 40–90 seconds, commonly about 60 seconds. The reason for that delay has not been isolated. This stable build retains the rc.2 startup behavior; it makes **no guaranteed startup-time claim**.

## Updating and compatibility

Windows users installed with the prior Setup.exe can use the in-app updater, which downloads and verifies the Squirrel feed before applying the update during a safe restart. Do not run Setup.exe over an active game or an open installation. macOS users download the matching DMG and replace the app manually. A Host closing the app ends its RAM-only room and all ongoing games; agree on a pause before updating. Version 1.9.0 remains compatible at protocol 14, although updating both desktop apps is recommended for the Online hosting fixes.

Cloudflare Quick Tunnels are temporary and have no uptime guarantee. A complete invitation link can work without the optional room registry; bare room-code discovery depends on that service. Cross-network guest joining, a complete Online game, real-device macOS hosting, and live upgrade from 1.9.0 or rc.2 have not been independently confirmed for this release.
